_comment: The other kingdoms: lands across the sea, each with its own map, robber barons and a good found nowhere else. Once your keep reaches keep_needed you found a castle there (cost taken from your main castle); it may build only `types`, its keep up to keep_cap. Its keep yields the kingdom's good: yield.rate per hour and keep level, holding up to yield.store per keep level until a ship takes it home (voyage seconds). Your armies sail from home against the kingdom's camps: voyage seconds, then the march from your castle there (positions are on the kingdom's own map, 0..size). `barons` overrides data/barons.json for those camps, whose loot includes the good. Goods have no storage cap, can't be looted or traded, and pay for elite soldiers (data/units.json) and master studies (data/buildings.json).

iron.name: Iron
iron.description: Frostmark iron, for elite soldiers and master studies.

glass.name: Glass
glass.description: Sunreach glass, for elite soldiers and master studies.

frostmark.name: Frostmark
frostmark.description: A frozen land of fjords and black pines far to the north. Its mountains are full of iron, and its barons fight over every vein.

sunreach.name: Sunreach
sunreach.description: Golden dunes and oasis towns far to the south. Its glassmakers have no equal, and its raiders strike from the deep desert.
